title: Kho-Kho
tagline: The chain chase: run, read, shout Kho
description: Kho-Kho is the chase sport of India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. Run the standing chaser, never turn back, and hand the chase to a seated teammate with Kho to cut the runners off; then swap sides and slip past the chasers yourself. Three grounds, hint, Auto Play, a full Rules page, large text and portrait or landscape play. No ads, works offline.
howToPlay: TAP or DRAG the court to run the standing chaser. Touch a runner to put them out.
You cannot cross the central lane or turn back.
Reach the back of a glowing seat and tap it, or press KHO, to hand the chase over.
Each hand-over flips you to the other half and lets you run the other way.
Touch all three runners before the clock runs out; then swap and run for yourself.
Eight batches make a match. Hint freezes the court and shows the computer's choice.
Keyboard: arrows run, Space gives Kho, 1 to 3 pick a runner, H hint.
